root_cause.mechanism: Path.read_text performs universal newline normalization. The entry validation at publication start hashes read_bytes and succeeds; the complete candidate loop later hashes read_text().encode and changes unchanged CRLF chapter bytes to LF. Every feedback-only publication still traverses all chapters, so the first CRLF body K-FW-011 fails before pending-plan creation.
